registration_history.note: first registration, for possession-v2.9; the match had not been accessed

the release changed before the match was accessed (goalkeeper team check, possession-v211-plan.json and possession-v211-results.json). Unchanged: design, copies, seeds, simulators, metric, reporting, decision rule and expectations. Changed: the release under test, and the tool (it calls the entry point named in this plan and records what the goalkeeper check moved on each copy).

registered_before: any access to the match. DFL J03WMX was set aside on 2026-11-07 (sportec-data-plan.json, split reserved_test). The assistant has never downloaded or read a file of it, and the cloud session that wrote this plan cannot reach the source. The project records (handoff of the external-data stage: reserved_test_not_downloaded) and a listing of the team's external-data folder made on 2026-11-11 show no file of it.
purpose: One measurement of the frozen release on a match that was never used to train, tune, select or check anything. Reported, not a gate.

release.name: possession-v2.11
release.entry_point: possession.run211.run, in its own process, on tracking files written from each copy (possession/epts_export.py)

fixture.competition: Bundesliga (DFL / Sportec open data, CC BY 4.0)
fixture.labels: provider flags BallStatus / BallPossession converted by tools/sportec_prepare.convert (D, H, A; X where the provider names no owner): the same kind of labels the models were trained on, not the competition's definition

design.corruption: possession.degrade with sample_params(rng, RANGES) for 'v2' and RANGES with player_sigma_m = (0.3, 0.6) for 'ext_players', rng = numpy default_rng(seed): the two profiles of the validations since possession-v25-plan.json
design.file_layout: tracklets packed into anonymous slots (half per team; a track lost for at most 25 frames returns to its slot, otherwise the slot free the longest), Metrica EPTS layout as documented for the provided ATD, coordinates written with 5 decimals
design.broadcast: experiments/possession_v2/synth_broadcast3.simulate_warp on the clean match; quality = synth_broadcast.sample_quality ('default') with bias / ball / player error ranges of the regime (tools/possession_final_test.REGIMES, the ranges of possession-v25-plan.json); rng = default_rng(stream_seed_base + 100 * regime_index + copy_index)
design.clock: experiments/possession_v2/synth_clock.observations for both recordings, p_read ~ U(0.5, 0.95) and p_misread ~ U(0.01, 0.03) per recording; rng = default_rng(clock_seed_base + 100 * regime_index + copy_index)
systems: baseline logic: the organisers' starter/baseline.py rule (nearest tracked player, majority vote over +-50 frames) on the corrupted copy
tactical only: the release entry point without broadcast files
broadcast good / medium / bad: the release entry point with a simulated broadcast stream and clock readings
design.metric: possession.evaluate.score = the organisers' possession_metrics on the play blocks: spellF1 (ranking metric) and macroF1
design.runs: 4 copies x (1 + 3) entry-point runs; every row and the mean per system are reported

reporting: possession-final-test-results.json holds every row, the means, the hashes of raw and prepared data, release, tool and simulators.
The tool refuses to run when that file exists: the test is run once. A run that stops half-way is resumed with the same rows.
The numbers go into the technical document as "reserved match, run once after freezing", next to the earlier numbers, whatever they are.
decision_rule: none. The release is not changed, retrained, re-thresholded or replaced because of this result. If the result is poor, that is reported as a limitation.

expectations_written_before_the_result.basis: validation copies of the two DFL validation matches, scored with models that had not seen them (K002 rows): tactical only 0.676 (profile v2, 0.641-0.726) and 0.633 (ext_players, 0.550-0.695); with a good / medium simulated broadcast +0.016 / +0.013 (v2) and +0.042 / +0.039 (ext_players); bad: gate closed
expectations_written_before_the_result.tactical only: mean of the four copies between 0.58 and 0.70 spellF1
expectations_written_before_the_result.broadcast good and medium: gate open on most copies; mean above tactical only by 0.01 to 0.05
expectations_written_before_the_result.broadcast bad: gate closed on every copy; identical to tactical only
expectations_written_before_the_result.goalkeeper team check: the provider's team ids are correct, so the check should move only goalkeeper pieces that our corruption put under the other id for 1-6 s; the expectations above (written for possession-v2.9) are kept unchanged, because on the validation copies with ids as corrupted possession-v2.11 scored the same as possession-v2.9

code_check_before_registration: the tool was run on the development match J03WN1 (which is part of the training set of the release, so its numbers mean nothing) to check that it works: once with copy 0 and the seeds of this plan (9101, 79000, 89000) before rehearsals were given their own seeds (+100000), then through the unit tests on a synthetic match. The copies of the final test are J03WMX with these seeds; none exists yet.
what_it_cannot_show: accuracy on the provided match: other provider, corrected tracking corrupted by our own simulator, labels of another definition
anything about the real broadcast stream: the stream is simulated by us
one match: differences below about 0.04 spellF1 are within match-to-match noise (EVALUATION.md)
seeds_checked_unused: 9101, 9102, 9501, 9502 and the twelve stream and twelve clock seeds (79000 + 100 * r + c, 89000 + 100 * r + c, r = 0..2, c = 0..3) occur in no earlier plan, results file, document or experiment script of the repository (each value searched on registration)
